properties.description: The ONE place a reply is bounded, so a tenth tool cannot quietly miss it. Trims prose progressively (4000/2000/800/240/120/0 characters) and never touches numbers, counts or ids. Shortening a LIST is opt-in via `Sampling::Allowed`; the default is Forbidden, so a vocabulary or catalogue overflows loudly rather than coming back as a complete-looking fragment. `NEVER_TRIM_BELOW` (80 chars) is what makes the 0 rung safe — names, ids and enum values survive every rung. Carries `BudgetReq` for the tools that took no arguments at all, which was most of the overflowing set. 8 unit tests, two of which pin bugs this module itself shipped and a committed test caught.
properties.name: reply_budget.rs
